finalText:
I took fresh screenshots of the 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9 artboards after my last edit and looked at each one, so all four have now been checked against the final file. The 1:1 and 4:5 show everything, including the "Zapiš se" button in the footer. The 16:9 cover shows the logos, both headline lines, the facts, the panel with the seven disciplines and the tail edge above the footer.

One gap is still open: a studio toolbar covers the bottom-right corner of the 16:9 screenshot. So I still can't see the "Zapiš se" button there; it's the same button that shows correctly on the 1:1 and 4:5. A quick look in the studio or an export would settle it.

Nothing else has changed since my last summary. The date (7. 10. 2026, already past) and the missing photos still need your call before you publish.
